Which of the following was a result of the Kansas-Nebraska Act of 1854?

F Fighting broke out between pro-slavery and anti-slavery groups in Kansas.

G Kansas entered the Union as a slave state through popular sovereignty in 1856.

H Nebraskan settlers who supported abolition moved to Kansas.

J The boundary established by the Missouri Compromise of 1820 was extended farther south.
